Pre-boil the chickpeas in fresh water.
Fry the onion in oil and add the tomato paste.
Add the chickpeas and hot water and cook for 50-70 minutes until completely soft.
Green lentil stew
1.5 cups green lentils
Rinse the lentils, pre-boil for 10 minutes and drain.
Chop the onion and carrot and sauté in oil.
Add the tomato paste and fry briefly.
Add the lentils and water and cook for 25-30 minutes until soft.
Borlotti beans pilaki
2 cups boiled borlotti beans
Chop the onion and soften in oil.
Dice the carrot and potato and sauté for 5 minutes.
Add the grated tomato, beans and water.
Cook over low heat for 25 minutes until the vegetables are soft; serve lukewarm.
Red lentil patties
1 tablespoon pepper paste
3 spring onions
Cook the lentils in 2.5 cups water until very soft.
Remove from the heat, add the bulgur and rest covered for 20 minutes.
Fry the onion in oil and add it with the paste to the lentil mixture.
Add finely chopped spring onions and lemon, knead and shape.
Black-eyed pea salad
2 cups boiled black-eyed peas
1 red pepper
Drain the boiled black-eyed peas and let them cool.
Finely chop the pepper, spring onions and parsley.
Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl.
Toss with olive oil and lemon and serve.
Spinach with chickpeas
400 g spinach
Wash the spinach in plenty of water and chop.
Fry the onion in oil and add the chopped tomato.
Add the chickpeas and spinach and stir.
Add the water and cook for 15-20 minutes until the spinach is soft.
White bean piyaz salad
2 cups boiled white beans
1 red onion
Drain the boiled beans and let them cool.
Slice the onion thinly and dice the tomato.
Combine the beans, onion, tomato and parsley.
Bulgur pilaf with lentils
1 cup coarse bulgur
Half a cup green lentils
2 cups hot water
Boil the lentils for 15-20 minutes so they stay slightly firm, then drain.
Fry the onion in oil.
Add the bulgur and lentils and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the hot water and cook over low heat until absorbed; rest for 10 minutes.
Zucchini with chickpeas
1 cup boiled chickpeas
Sauté the onion in oil.
Cut the zucchini into half-moons and grate the tomatoes.
Add the zucchini, tomatoes and chickpeas to the pot.
Add the water and cook for 20-25 minutes until the zucchini is soft.
Pasta with tomato
250 g pasta
2 cloves garlic
1 teaspoon dried basil
Boil the pasta in plenty of boiling water according to the package time.
Briefly sauté the garlic in oil and add the grated tomato.
Cook the sauce for 10 minutes until thick and add the basil.
Mix the drained pasta with the sauce and serve hot.
Pasta with basil
1 bunch basil
2 tablespoons grated cheese
Boil the pasta according to the package time.
Blend the basil, walnuts, garlic and oil in a food processor.
Loosen the sauce with a few spoonfuls of pasta water.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and cheese.
Pasta with mushrooms
250 g mushrooms
Half a tea glass pasta water
Boil the pasta in boiling water.
Slice the mushrooms and sauté with the onion in oil until their liquid evaporates.
Add the garlic and stir for 1 minute.
Add the pasta water and cooked pasta and toss.
Noodles with vegetables
250 g noodles (erişte)
1 zucchini
Boil the noodles in boiling water until soft and drain.
Cut the carrot, zucchini and pepper into thin strips.
Sauté the vegetables in oil for 8-10 minutes until soft.
Combine the noodles with the vegetables and stir for 2 minutes.
Bulgur pilaf
Fry the onion in the fats until soft.
Add the grated tomato and let the liquid evaporate.
Add the washed bulgur and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the hot water and cook covered over low heat for 15 minutes; let rest.
Rice pilaf
1 cup rice
1.5 cups hot water
Half a teaspoon salt
Wash the rice until the starch is gone and drain.
Heat the fats in a pot and toast the rice for 3 minutes.
Add the hot water and salt and cover.
Cook over low heat until the water is absorbed; let rest for 10 minutes.
Vegetable pilaf with quinoa
1 cup quinoa
Rinse the quinoa in a fine sieve with plenty of water.
Sauté the chopped vegetables in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the quinoa and water and bring to a boil.
Cook covered over low heat for 15 minutes and rest for 5 minutes.
Buckwheat pilaf
1 cup buckwheat
Rinse and drain the buckwheat.
Sauté the chopped onion and carrot in oil.
Add the buckwheat and hot water.
Cook over low heat for 15-20 minutes until the grains are soft and the water is absorbed.
Baked pasta
250 g pasta for baking
2 cups milk
2 tablespoons flour
2 tablespoons butter
1 cup grated kashar cheese
Boil the pasta so it stays slightly firm.
Toast the flour in butter for 1 minute, add the milk gradually and thicken.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and transfer to a baking dish.
Sprinkle with kashar and bake at 190°C for 20-25 minutes until golden.
Couscous with chickpeas
1 cup couscous
Boil the couscous in boiling water according to the package time and drain.
Chop the pepper small and sauté in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and heat through.
Mix with the couscous, add lemon juice and serve.
Oven chicken, potatoes
600 g chicken drumsticks
3 potatoes
1 dessert spoon thyme
1 teaspoon paprika
Preheat the oven to 200°C; cut the potatoes into large slices.
Toss the drumsticks and potatoes with oil, thyme and paprika and arrange in a single layer on the tray.
Bake for about 45–55 minutes; check that the internal temperature at the thickest part of the chicken reaches 74°C.
Chicken sauté with vegetables
400 g chicken breast
Cut the chicken into thin strips; chop the onion, zucchini and pepper to the same size.
Heat the oil in a pan and stir-fry the chicken over high heat until browned.
Add the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, then the zucchini and sauté for another 6–8 minutes.
Serve when the chicken’s internal temperature reaches 74°C.
Lemon chicken
500 g chicken breast
Mix the lemon juice, crushed garlic, olive oil and thyme.
Coat the chicken in the sauce and leave in the fridge for 20 minutes.
Brown both sides in a pan over medium heat; cook for 12–18 minutes depending on thickness.
Remove from the heat when the internal temperature is 74°C; let rest for 3 minutes.
Chicken pilaf
300 g chicken breast
1.5 cups chicken stock
Boil the chicken in water until fully cooked and shred it; reserve the stock.
Wash and drain the rice and toast it with the fats for 3 minutes.
Add the measured chicken stock and cook over low heat until absorbed.
Add the shredded chicken and rest covered for 10 minutes.
Chicken pasta
Boil the pasta according to the time on the package.
Cook the diced chicken in oil; check that the internal temperature reaches 74°C.
Add the garlic and grated tomato and simmer for 8 minutes.
Drain the pasta and mix it with the chicken sauce.
Chicken skewers
Cut the chicken and peppers into cubes suitable for skewers.
